title: Screen: when drying ends, the drying page's Start button is enabled again, and a drying stopped early (from Fluidd) leaves the drying page like Stop on the screen
note: The drying settings page keeps a pointer to its Start button (saved in a free slot of .q2_queue_state when the page is drawn). When the drying state changes to 'not drying', the Start button is re-evaluated with QIDI's own rule (disabled only while the printer is busy). The code also checks the planned end time (saved by screen-drying-autoshow): if drying stopped more than a minute early, that is a stop from Fluidd or the console, and a screen that shows drying calls QIDI's own 'back' function (queued on the GUI queue), exactly what Stop on the screen does in stock firmware. A drying that ends because its time is up keeps QIDI's behaviour (drying settings page). Stop on the screen is unchanged. Code: 37 instructions in the free part of .q2_queue_text.
